ALLOW_DUPLICATE_EFFECT: Two hashes cannot authenticate one raw byte stream; allowing role hashes at one key makes lookup/replay ambiguous or bypasses coverage. No formal justification to relax uniqueness.
ASSURANCE: One immutable byte object per lookup key; exact identity-bound deterministic replay and source-loss/invalidation. Anti-laundering is an inference from these checks, not a separate claimed protocol.
NATIVE_KEY_RULE: Exact match with implementation; m.unique rejects distinct identities using the same lookup coordinates
PATH_RULE: Nonempty canonical relative POSIX path; reject absolute, .., noncanonical separators and symlink aliases; resolve under one repository root. RAW cannot project a JSON section.
RAW_KEY_SEMANTICS: ArtifactPin key = (path, pointer, HashProfile). RAW pointer must be empty; profile namespace raw-file-sha256; effective raw key = (canonical relative path, "", RAW). Identity digest, semantic role, source type and provenance section are not extra lookup coordinates.
WHY_FAILS: Path.as_posix collapses double slash after colon
No native URI resolver or scheme semantics
Two role payloads still require different raw file objects after lexical normalization
